question: List the full names and majors of members who wear 'Large' t-shirts and attended events that had more than 15 attendees.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T2."XCL_035", T2."XCL_036", T1."XCL_031"
FROM major AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1."XCL_030" = T2."XCL_042"
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2."XCL_034" = T3."XCL_002"
WHERE T2."XCL_039" = 'Large'
  AND T3."XCL_001" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_001" FROM attendance GROUP BY "XCL_001" HAVING COUNT("XCL_002") > 15
  )
